detector.description: Alerts when K8s Node is using memory > 90% for 5m
detector.name: K8S Node Memory is higher than 90% for 5m
detector.programText:
A = data('memory.utilization', filter=filter('k8s.cluster.name', '*')).sum(by=['host', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='A')
detect(when(A > threshold(90), lasting='5m'), auto_resolve_after='1d').publish('K8S Node Memory is higher than 90% for 5m')

rules.description: The value of Memory Utilization is above 90.
rules.detectLabel: K8S Node Memory is higher than 90% for 5m
